# `_llm_float` is invisible to the env-var registry scanner: 4 undocumented env vars

## Context / Problem
`scripts/gen_env_registry.py` generates `docs/env-vars.md` from env-var reads under `src/rebar`, and
a CI drift gate fails the build when the committed doc disagrees (`.github/workflows/_build-and-test.yml:314`).
The generator recognises a read only when the callee is a KNOWN helper AND the name argument is a
STRING LITERAL (`gen_env_registry.py:117-124`); `KNOWN_ENV_HELPERS` at `:37-47` registers
`"_llm_str": (2, "")` and `"_llm_int": (2, "")`.

**`_llm_float` is NOT registered.** So every env var read through it is silently absent from the
generated registry. MEASURED by running the generator: `REBAR_LLM_TEMPERATURE` (`llm/config.py:651`),
`REBAR_LLM_OVERLAP_MAX_DOC_FREQ` (`:692`), `REBAR_LLM_OVERLAP_MIN_SHOULD_MATCH` (`:699`) and
`REBAR_LLM_OVERLAP_CONF_THRESHOLD` (`:720`) are all real, settable, operator-facing knobs and NONE
appears in `docs/env-vars.md`.

This is exactly the bug class the registry exists to prevent, and the gate is currently GREEN while
incomplete — a clean `--check` is therefore not evidence of completeness. `_llm_float` is defined at
`llm/config.py:459-476` alongside `_llm_str` (`:426-436`) and `_llm_int` (`:439-456`); the omission is
an oversight, not a decision.

## Approach
Add `"_llm_float": (2, "")` to `KNOWN_ENV_HELPERS` and regenerate `docs/env-vars.md`.

Land this BEFORE any structural change to `config.py`, so the derived-doc diff caused by fixing the
scanner is not tangled with the diff caused by moving code. That keeps both changes reviewable.

**Also close the hole that let this hide:** the existing test
`tests/unit/test_llm_config_pointer.py:259-267` asserts one specific var is statically visible to the
generator. Generalize the idea — assert that the helper registry covers every `_llm_*` resolver
defined in `llm/config.py`, so adding a fifth resolver without registering it fails a test rather
than silently dropping knobs from the docs.

## Scope
- `scripts/gen_env_registry.py` — one entry in `KNOWN_ENV_HELPERS`.
- `docs/env-vars.md` — regenerated, not hand-edited.
- `tests/unit/` — the completeness assertion.

## Testing
- a test asserts each of the four named vars appears in the generated registry (fails today).
- a test asserts every `_llm_*` helper defined in `llm/config.py` is present in `KNOWN_ENV_HELPERS`,
  so the next resolver cannot be added unregistered.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] a test asserts `REBAR_LLM_TEMPERATURE`, `REBAR_LLM_OVERLAP_MAX_DOC_FREQ`,
      `REBAR_LLM_OVERLAP_MIN_SHOULD_MATCH` and `REBAR_LLM_OVERLAP_CONF_THRESHOLD` are all present in
      the generated env registry. This criterion FAILS against the current implementation
- [ ] a test asserts every `_llm_*` resolver defined in `src/rebar/llm/config.py` is registered in
      `KNOWN_ENV_HELPERS`, so an unregistered future resolver is caught
- [ ] `python scripts/gen_env_registry.py` leaves the tree clean and `docs/env-vars.md` is committed
      as generated output
